clue.text: Credit with having the very best

parts.note: CR is the standard abbreviation for credit in accounts
having something means owning it

explanation.surface: Someone is given credit for possessing the finest of things.
explanation.definitionFit: A crowning achievement is the supreme or topmost one, the peak of a career.

clue.text: Love prison, that's plain!

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, written as the letter O
a pen is an enclosure, and slang for a prison (short for penitentiary)

explanation.surface: An exclamation that loving a prison is a plain matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Something open is plain and obvious, as in an open secret, nothing hidden.

clue.text: A street light not in the right place

parts.note: a ray is a beam of light

explanation.surface: A street lamp has been put up somewhere it should not be.
explanation.definitionFit: Something gone astray has wandered off and is lost or misplaced.

clue.text: Don't run so much, even though showing no distress

definitions.meaning: an instruction to tear about less, read as two words

explanation.surface: Advice to ease off running even though the runner looks perfectly calm.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone tearless sheds no tears, so shows no sign of grief or upset.

clue.text: Men point to new organisation as supremely powerful

indicators.note: giving the letters a new organisation means arranging them afresh

explanation.surface: Men point to a newly formed organisation as being all-powerful.
explanation.definitionFit: Omnipotent literally means all-powerful, having unlimited might.

clue.text: A goddess writing one note after another

parts.note: A is a note of the musical scale
then means afterwards, next in sequence
another note of the scale, here E

explanation.surface: A goddess is busy composing music, setting down one note after another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Writing' tells you to write out the phrase literally: one note (A), then another (E), giving A THEN E.
explanation.definitionFit: Athene, also Athena, is the Greek goddess of wisdom and patron of Athens.

clue.text: He moves the ordinary seaman into decent accommodation

indicators.note: the seaman goes into the other word, which accommodates him

parts.note: decent and proper both mean respectable

explanation.surface: Someone relocates a junior sailor into respectable lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He moves' is not about relocation: a proposer moves a motion at a meeting. 'Accommodation' supports 'into' as the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: At a debate or meeting the proposer is the person who moves, that is formally puts forward, a motion.

clue.text: Not so reasonable — really a bit of a pig

definitions.meaning: a slice of bacon, which comes from a pig

explanation.surface: Someone less sensible is described as behaving rather like a pig.
explanation.definitionFit: Rasher is the comparative of rash, and also a thin slice of bacon or ham.

clue.text: There's ill-feeling, maybe, any time an article's missed

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters might be arranged some other way
an article is missed, so it is dropped from the phrase

parts.note: A is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: There may be bad feeling whenever someone leaves out an item.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missed' removes A from ANYTIME, leaving NYTIME, which 'maybe' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Enmity is hostility or ill-will between people, a state of being enemies.

clue.text: A woman wanting information about the West

indicators.note: the information wraps about the other letter, enclosing it

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
W is the abbreviation for west

explanation.surface: A woman is seeking facts about the western regions.
explanation.definitionFit: Gwen is a woman's name, a short form of Gwendolen.

clue.text: Held in check, so fell behind others

indicators.note: the falling comes behind, that is after, the others

parts.note: the rest are the others, the remainder
rain fell, so it rained

explanation.surface: A runner was held back and so dropped behind the field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fell' looks like tumbling in a race; it is rain falling.
explanation.definitionFit: Restrained means held back or kept under control.

clue.text: Give the underworld boss a month and cause consternation

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld
May is a month of the year

explanation.surface: Granting the ruler of the dead a month off would cause alarm.
explanation.definitionFit: To dismay is to alarm or dishearten, filling someone with consternation.

clue.text: The way to restrict relaxation

parts.note: a mode is a way or manner of doing something
to ration is to restrict supply

explanation.surface: A lifestyle tip that limiting yourself is the way to relax.
explanation.definitionFit: Moderation can mean the relaxation or easing of something severe, a lessening.

clue.text: Looks on minerals as horrible things

parts.note: to eye something is to look at it
ores are minerals from which metal is extracted

explanation.surface: Someone regards mineral deposits as ugly blots on the landscape.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyesores are things unpleasant to look at, ugly sights.

clue.text: Rush around and secure a useful appliance

parts.note: to gad about is to rush around restlessly
to secure something is to get it

explanation.surface: Hurry about and obtain a handy device.
explanation.definitionFit: A gadget is a small handy tool or device.

clue.text: Presentation is all-important to a photographer

definitions.meaning: a showing or display of something to the public
the amount of light let onto the film or sensor

explanation.surface: How a picture is presented matters greatly to the person taking it.
explanation.definitionFit: Exposure is public display, and in photography the light admitted to make an image.

clue.text: The wrong set can rise

indicators.note: wrong suggests the letters are in the wrong order and must be fixed

explanation.surface: The faulty set of tins is able to climb.
explanation.definitionFit: An ascent is a climb or upward slope, a rise.

clue.text: Lists the wild plants

indicators.note: wild suggests the letters are running out of control into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone lists the plants growing wild.
explanation.definitionFit: Thistles are prickly flowering plants, the Scottish national emblem among them.

clue.text: Property of some interest — a tentative offer seems likely

indicators.note: the answer is made of some letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A house attracts interest, and an offer is expected soon.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate is a piece of property, especially land or a large house.

clue.text: Drawing lines

parts.note: not sketched marks but ropes used for pulling vehicles

explanation.definitionFit: Ropes used for towing are lines that draw, meaning pull, a vehicle.

clue.text: Gain or otherwise from rowing

indicators.note: otherwise means in a different form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Whether you gain anything or not from taking up rowing.
explanation.definitionFit: Oaring is propelling a boat with oars, that is, rowing.

clue.text: Report to do with extremity

parts.note: re means concerning, to do with
a tail is the hind end, an extremity

explanation.surface: A report concerning the far end of something.
explanation.definitionFit: To retail a story is to recount or report it in detail.

clue.text: Wheel to turn in class

indicators.note: one piece goes in the other

parts.note: rate means class or grade, as in first-rate

indicators.note: turn means the little word is turned round

explanation.surface: A wheel takes its turn in a group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wheel' looks like a noun but is the verb: to wheel round. 'turn' and 'in' are the indicators; 'class' is not a school group but a grade.
explanation.definitionFit: To wheel is to turn round, to rotate.

clue.text: Church member taking professional examination sitting by a social worker

parts.note: pro is short for professional
a test is an examination
an ant is a worker insect in a social colony

explanation.surface: A churchgoer is taking a professional exam beside a social worker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' is not a welfare officer: ants are social insects, many of them workers.
explanation.definitionFit: A Protestant is a member of a Western church that broke from Rome at the Reformation.

clue.text: Corpulent oriental lot!

parts.note: corpulent means fat
E for east, oriental meaning eastern

explanation.surface: An exclamation about a stout eastern group.
explanation.definitionFit: Your lot in life is your fate or destiny.

clue.text: Thin sheet metal used for fencing

definitions.meaning: a very thin flexible metal sheet, as in kitchen use
a light blunted sword in the sport of fencing

explanation.surface: Thin metal sheeting is used to put up a fence.
explanation.definitionFit: Foil is metal beaten thin, and also the light sword used in sport fencing.

clue.text: Being trendy, cross over under cover

parts.note: in means fashionable, trendy

indicators.note: over means the word is turned over, read backwards

parts.note: a rood is a cross or crucifix

explanation.surface: Being fashionable, someone crosses to the other side and takes shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: Indoor means inside a building, under cover from the weather.

clue.text: In consequence the cord gets twisted

indicators.note: the cord goes in the other word

parts.note: an end is a result or consequence
twine is string or cord

explanation.surface: As a result, the string becomes tangled.
explanation.definitionFit: Entwined means twisted together or around one another.
